purpose: Bounded primary-source research notes for investigation of failed V4 controls; not a validated replacement formula.

sources.supports: 2025/26 successful-tackle scoring changed from the previous won-minus-lost net statistic to won tackles. Does not establish old clipping, raw-feed mapping or the full historical formula.
2016 explanation gives minimum 30 attempted passes and three completion tiers with 2/4/6 BPS. Does not prove identity of a particular archived pass counter or rounding behavior.

Tackles won/lost differ according to subsequent possession; being beaten by a dribble is a separate challenge-lost concept. Blocks are defined for attempts at goal. Pass-completion calculations depend on the selected pass combination. A key pass leads to a non-goal shot, while chances created add conventional assists. These definitions require exact feed-to-FPL mapping rather than proxy substitution.
